correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive F2 linear algebra reconstructed the nine evaluation functionals, rank 9, and 16-dimensional vanishing kernel of the 25 monomials, giving exactly 65535 nonzero filling equations. A distinct polynomial-generator basis via DX and DY reproduced this kernel. Rational-point Jacobian tests leave 3648 masks. Independently constructed all 72 ((PGL2(F2))² ⋊ C2) actions and obtained 54 rationally smooth orbits: 49×72,2×36,1×24,2×12. Fresh SymPy Groebner unit-ideal tests of (f,fx,fy) on all four affine charts of every orbit representative retained precisely 34 geometric-smooth orbits (31×72,2×36,1×24), totaling 2328 masks; these tests were independent of stored outputs. Smooth ample bidegree (4,4) divisors on P1×P1 cannot decompose into disjoint components, hence are integral; adjunction gives genus 9. Exact count is of embedded curves/equations, not abstract isomorphism classes.
